description: List directories and listing sites where an indie product can be submitted, from the open launch-directories dataset (CC BY 4.0). Rows include public eligibility, reciprocity, free-tier conditions, field-specific sources and checked dates. Use checked=true for source-backed options. Provider claims are not independently observed listing links. Blank/unknown stays unknown. Run run_launch_check on the product site before submitting.

checked.description: Only source-backed eligibility and free-tier options; not guaranteed approval.

dofollow.description: Only directories whose link is dofollow or dofollow with a badge.

free.description: Only directories with a free option.

product_type.description: Public product class, such as software, digital_product or website.

name: list_launch_directories
